manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the kitchen microwave with slanted shape's handle and pull to open it.

Task description: The object is the microwave at the center of the tabletop, with a vertical handle on the front right of its door. Grasp the handle and pull the door outward.

Success criteria: The oven door is open to at least 60% of its maximum travel; merely opening a narrow gap does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Grip the straight section between the upper and lower handle joints, with the fingers closing toward each other across its width. Avoid the end joints to get effective contact and leave room for rotation.
- Set the gripper opening to fit the handle width and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the handle, avoiding a visual overlap that in fact catches the door or the panel on the right.
- When pulling, follow the oven door's actual rotation around its hinge, moving and turning the gripper with the handle instead of pulling along a fixed straight line and causing a slip or jam.
- Use the open space directly in front of the microwave to adjust wrist orientation. Minimize large lateral swings while approaching and opening the door to avoid the bowl on the left or bottles and jars on the right.
